title: Commutation up to natural isomorphism for logical topological groupoids
author: Ali Hamad
work: Generalised ultracategories and conceptual completeness of geometric logic
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's Lemma of Section 4 (source0.tex lines 1878--1902), on the natural isomorphism comparing two logical topological groupoids along a morphism in the image of the category P, delivered with the author's own complete proof at source0.tex lines 1904--1919. H2: the proof is a genuine topos-theoretic comparison rather than a qualifying examination exercise. The solver must pass from a sheaf in the topos to its two realizations as an equivariant sheaf along the geometric morphisms attached to the two groupoids, write the two étale spaces over the object spaces $G_0$ and $G^{\prime}_0$ of the groupoids, observe that the underlying sets of the two constructions agree up to isomorphism, and then verify that the topology induced on the one is the pullback of the topology on the other by comparing the basic open sets $U_{i_1,\dots,i_n,C}$ that define the topology of a logical topological groupoid. The 2-categorical setting, the groupoid-equivariant sheaf description and the pullback-topology comparison are well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying level.

primary.theorem: The article's Lemma of Section 4 (source lines 1878--1902)
